advisories.title: eMudhra intermediate CA private keys recoverable from the certificates
advisories.applicability: Any machine, container image or runtime that carries a CA trust store: Linux, macOS, Windows or BSD, plus every bundled copy in Python, Java, Node, Go, Rust and desktop applications

advisories.title: PHP2Shell: unauthenticated remote code execution in every PHP web SAPI (CVE-2026-109618, CVE-2026-109619)
advisories.applicability: Any host, container image or appliance that runs a PHP interpreter below the floor and accepts HTTP requests through it: web servers, control panels, CI runners that serve PHP, developer machines with a local PHP stack
